flagged.evidence: [F7] states that the elementary symmetric polynomial e_n is sum_{σ∈S_n} x_{σ(1)}⋯x_{σ(n)}. The cited def-elementary-symmetric-polynomials defines e_k as the sum over increasing k-element index sets, so e_n=x_1⋯x_n; the [F7] formula is n! times that. Accordingly, Proof 2.3's stated substitution gives n! T_1⋯T_n under [F7], not T_1⋯T_n. Dividing by n! over C repairs that proof step, but does not make [F7]'s formula correct.

The Remark cites lem-largest-entry-of-a-standard-tableau-is-removable for the claim that f^λ matches dim_C S^λ. That dependency's Statement only says the box containing n is removable and deleting it leaves a standard tableau of size n−1; it gives no dimension result. The published thm-standard-polytabloid-basis states dim_C S^λ=f^λ.
